summary: LEIFRAS Co., Ltd., a Japanese foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an investment agreement with Oriental Land Innovations Co., Ltd. (OLI). OLI will acquire 400,041 treasury ordinary shares at JPY345 per share, approximately JPY138 million (US$0.87 million) gross, expected to close November 27, 2026, alongside a concurrent private sale by CEO Kiyotaka Ito of 4,723,000 shares to OLI. The board and audit/supervisory committee approved on October 29, 2026. OLI gains a director nomination, board observer, preemptive and consent rights; resale registration due within 45 days of closing; Reg S private placement. Watch closing conditions tying both legs and post-deal OLI ownership and overhang.
